narrative.headline: Right on the cut line
narrative.blurb: The Jays are within shouting distance of the last wild-card spot. This is a real October hunt.

magicNumber.hint: Jays wins + MIN losses to clinch a playoff spot
magicNumber.detail: Any mix of Jays wins and MIN losses that adds to 36 locks a playoff spot. Winning out still requires 2 MIN losses. East title is 51 vs TB.

injuries.name: Ryan McMahon
injuries.comment: McMahon is out of the lineup for Sunday's game against the Phillies.

injuries.name: Cody Bellinger
injuries.comment: Yankees manager Aaron Boone said Wednesday on the "Talkin' Yanks" podcast by Jomboy Media that Bellinger (hamstring) could be activated from the 10-day injured list as soon as Sunday.

injuries.name: Max Fried
injuries.comment: Yankees manager Aaron Boone said Tuesday that Fried (elbow) could return from the injured list immediately after he completes the required 15-day stay, Bryan Hoch of MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Aaron Judge
injuries.comment: Yankees manager Aaron Boone said Tuesday that Judge (ribs) will begin a hitting progression this week, Bryan Hoch of MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Clarke Schmidt
injuries.comment: Yankees manager Aaron Boone said Sunday that Schmidt (elbow) will be preparing to return from the 60-day injured list as a reliever, Gary Phillips of the New York Daily News reports. "That can always change as the weeks and month unfolds, just depending," Boone said, regarding Schmidt's potential role. "But that's kind of how we're looking at."

injuries.name: Giancarlo Stanton
injuries.comment: Manager Aaron Boone said that Stanton (calf) did some baserunning Saturday, but the Yankees remain uncertain when the five-time All-Star will be ready to begin a rehab assignment, MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Kervin Castro
injuries.comment: The Yankees placed Castro on the 15-day injured list Tuesday, retroactive to Monday, with right elbow neuritis.

injuries.name: Roman Anthony
injuries.comment: Anthony (finger) served as the designated hitter and went 2-for-2 with two walks, a home run and two RBI for Double-A Portland on Tuesday.

injuries.name: Masataka Yoshida
injuries.comment: Interim manager Chad Tracy revealed Tuesday that Yoshida has a "significant" left hamstring injury that will keep him out until close to the end of the season, at minimum, Tim Healey of The Boston Globe reports.

injuries.name: Tanner Houck
injuries.comment: Houck (elbow) tossed a live bullpen session to batters Tuesday, Tim Healey of The Boston Globe reports.

injuries.name: Trevor Story
injuries.comment: Story (sports hernia) said that he could be reinstated from the 60-day injured list as soon as Friday, Chris Cotillo of MassLive.com reports.

injuries.name: Justin Slaten
injuries.comment: The Red Sox placed Slaten (elbow) on the 15-day injured list Sunday.

injuries.name: Isiah Kiner-Falefa
injuries.comment: Kiner-Falefa (forearm) will start his rehab assignment Wednesday with Triple-A Worcester, Sean McAdam of MassLive.com reports.

injuries.name: Garrett Whitlock
injuries.comment: The Red Sox placed Whitlock on the 15-day injured list Thursday with right elbow inflammation, Chris Cotillo of MassLive.com reports.

injuries.name: Triston Casas
injuries.comment: Casas (abdomen/knee) underwent arthroscopic surgery on his left wrist Thursday.

injuries.name: Garrett Crochet
injuries.comment: Interim Red Sox manager Chad Tracy said Tuesday that Crochet (lat/shoulder) has resumed throwing from 50-to-60 feet on flat ground, Mac Cerullo of the Boston Herald reports.

injuries.name: Curtis Mead
injuries.comment: Mead has a nondisplaced left wrist fracture and will be reimaged in four weeks, Ian Browne of MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Zack Kelly
injuries.comment: The Red Sox recalled Kelly (elbow) from Triple-A Worcester and placed him on the 60-day injured list Tuesday, Tim Healey of The Boston Globe reports.

injuries.name: Johan Oviedo
injuries.comment: Oviedo (elbow) will throw a bullpen session next week, Chris Cotillo of MassLive.com reports.

injuries.name: Kutter Crawford
injuries.comment: The Red Sox announced June 29 that Crawford (forearm) has been throwing plyometric balls during workouts at the team's spring training facility in Florida, MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Joe Ryan
injuries.comment: Ryan (glute) threw a 25-pitch bullpen session Tuesday, Dan Hayes of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Austin Martin
injuries.comment: Twins manager Derek Shelton said that Martin sustained a left hamstring strain in the eighth inning of Sunday's 7-5 loss to the Phillies and will be sent in for an MRI, Aaron Gleeman of Aaron Gleeman.com reports.

injuries.name: Mike Paredes
injuries.comment: The Twins transferred Paredes (oblique) from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day IL on Saturday.

injuries.name: Cole Sands
injuries.comment: Sands will undergo arthroscopic surgery Tuesday to remove loose bodies and bone spurs from his right elbow, Jack Azoulay-Haron of ElEmergente.com reports.

injuries.name: David Festa
injuries.comment: Festa (shoulder) will undergo a season-ending double surgery Wednesday, Dan Hayes of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Mick Abel
injuries.comment: The Twins plan to re-evaluate Abel (elbow) on Sept. 1, Dan Hayes of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Anthony Banda
injuries.comment: Banda underwent surgery to repair his left lat strain and will miss the remainder of the 2026 season, Dan Hayes of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Pablo Lopez
injuries.comment: The Twins placed Lopez (elbow) on the 60-day injured list Thursday.

injuries.name: Jack Leiter
injuries.comment: Leiter (ankle) said Tuesday that he will make at least one more rehab start this week before potentially coming off the injured list, Jeff Wilson of AllDLLS.com reports.

injuries.name: Josh Jung
injuries.comment: Jung (calf) did some running on the field Sunday and could be cleared to begin a defensive progression within the next few days, Shawn McFarland of The Dallas Morning News reports.

injuries.name: Nathan Eovaldi
injuries.comment: The Rangers placed Eovaldi on the 15-day injured list Monday with right posterior elbow inflammation.

injuries.name: Jose Corniell
injuries.comment: The Rangers placed Corniell on the 15-day injured list Tuesday with an elbow injury, Jeff Wilson of AllDLLS.com reports.

injuries.name: Jalen Beeks
injuries.comment: The Rangers transferred Beeks (forearm) to the 60-day injured list Tuesday.

injuries.name: Kyle Higashioka
injuries.comment: Higashioka is not in the lineup for Monday's game against the White Sox.

injuries.name: Michael Helman
injuries.comment: Texas transferred Helman (hand) to the 60-day injured list Friday.

injuries.name: Robert Garcia
injuries.comment: The Rangers transferred Garcia (shoulder) from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day IL on Monday.

injuries.name: Carter Baumler
injuries.comment: Baumler (intercostal) has been shut down from his rehab assignment, MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Andres Gimenez
injuries.comment: Gimenez was removed from Thursday's game versus the Rays in the fourth inning with a right hamstring injury, Shi Davidi of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries.name: Spencer Arrighetti
injuries.comment: Blue Jays manager John Schneider said Thursday that Arrighetti (foot) is "on track to pitch [Friday] if we need him," Shi Davidi of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries.name: Vladimir Guerrero Jr.
injuries.comment: Guerrero has cleared concussion protocol and will play a rehab game with Single-A Dunedin on Thursday, Mitch Bannon of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Brett Bateman
injuries.comment: Bateman (hamstring) is not in the lineup for Thursday's contest versus the Rays.

injuries.name: Joe Mantiply
injuries.comment: Mantiply (knee) began a rehab assignment with Single-A Dunedin on Wednesday, striking out one in a perfect inning.

injuries.name: Trey Yesavage
injuries.comment: Yesavage (knee) resumed throwing from flat ground Tuesday, Arden Zwelling of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries.name: Jameson Taillon
injuries.comment: Taillon (forearm) resumed a throwing program with some flat-ground work Tuesday, Arden Zwelling of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries.name: Jake Bloss
injuries.comment: The Blue Jays recalled Bloss from Triple-A Buffalo on Wednesday and placed him on the 60-day injured list while he recovers from a right teres major strain, Arden Zwelling of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries.name: Luis Urias
injuries.comment: The Blue Jays announced Monday that Urias (quadriceps) will be shut down for the next two weeks, Ben Nicholson-Smith of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries.name: Yimi Garcia
injuries.comment: Garcia (elbow/neck/biceps) has been diagnosed with thoracic outlet syndrome and is expected to miss the remainder of the 2026 season, Mitch Bannon of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Patrick Corbin
injuries.comment: Toronto transferred Corbin (shoulder) from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day IL on Wednesday.

injuries.name: Addison Barger
injuries.comment: Barger is expected to be sidelined six months following surgery Monday to repair his right elbow UCL, Shi Davidi of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries.name: Jonatan Clase
injuries.comment: Clase (foot) isn't in the lineup for Wednesday's game against the Rays.

injuries.name: Anthony Santander
injuries.comment: Santander is still dealing with discomfort in his surgically repaired left shoulder and recently received another cortisone shot, Keegan Matheson of MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Jose Berrios
injuries.comment: Blue Jays manager John Schneider said that Berrios underwent full Tommy John surgery Wednesday in addition to having a stress fracture repaired, Hazel Mae of Sportsnet reports.

injuries.name: Cody Ponce
injuries.comment: Ponce underwent surgery Friday to repair the ACL in his right knee, Arden Zwelling of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries.name: Bowden Francis
injuries.comment: The Blue Jays placed Francis (elbow) on the 60-day injured list Wednesday.

injuries.name: Chase DeLauter
injuries.comment: DeLauter (hamstring) is absent from the lineup for Thursday's game against the Giants.

injuries.name: Jo Adell
injuries.comment: Adell (knee) remains out of the lineup for Thursday's game against the Giants.

injuries.name: Slade Cecconi
injuries.comment: Cecconi (arm) recently threw a bullpen session and is scheduled for another bullpen this week before beginning a rehab assignment, Tim Stebbins of MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Rhys Hoskins
injuries.comment: Hoskins went 2-for-3 with a two-run home run and a walk in Saturday's 6-3 loss to the White Sox.

injuries.name: Colin Holderman
injuries.comment: Holderman was removed from Saturday's 6-1 win over the Padres due to right wrist inflammation, Tim Stebbins of MLB.com reports. He was credited with a hold while hitting a batter and retiring the other two hitters he faced.

injuries.name: Shawn Armstrong
injuries.comment: The Guardians transferred Armstrong (calf) to the 60-day injured list Tuesday.

injuries.name: Blaze Alexander
injuries.comment: X-rays taken Tuesday showed that Alexander's fractured left hand is fully healed, and he is aiming to rejoin the Orioles' active roster for their series against the Athletics that runs Aug. 28-30, Jake Rill of MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Felix Bautista
injuries.comment: Bautista (shoulder) could begin a rehab assignment within the next week, Roch Kubatko of MASN Sports reports.

injuries.name: Ryan Helsley
injuries.comment: Helsley (elbow) said Sunday that he's about a week into his throwing program but is likely a couple of weeks away from getting back on a mound, Andy Kostka of TheBanner.com reports.

injuries.name: Colin Selby
injuries.comment: Orioles president of baseball operations Mike Elias said Friday that Selby underwent right shoulder surgery Tuesday to repair his labrum and rotator cuff, Andy Kostka of TheBanner.com reports.

injuries.name: Ryan Mountcastle
injuries.comment: The Orioles announced that Mountcastle (foot) suffered a "significant" oblique strain while warming up for his first rehab game and will now be out a couple more months, Jake Rill of MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Keegan Akin
injuries.comment: Akin (elbow) underwent Tommy John surgery Wednesday, Jake Rill of MLB.com  reports.

injuries.name: Jordan Westburg
injuries.comment: Westburg (elbow) underwent Tommy John surgery Wednesday, Andrew Golden of TheBanner.com reports.

injuries.name: Zach Eflin
injuries.comment: Eflin underwent Tommy John surgery on his right elbow Wednesday, Andy Kostka of TheBaltimoreBanner.com reports.

injuries.name: Kerry Carpenter
injuries.comment: Carpenter (foot) will pause his rehab program after suffering a setback, Jason Beck of MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Jack Flaherty
injuries.comment: The Tigers announced Friday that Flaherty (forearm) has increased the intensity and distance of his throwing progression, MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: James Outman
injuries.comment: The Tigers placed Outman on the 7-day concussion injured list Thursday.

injuries.name: Riley Greene
injuries.comment: Greene exited Tuesday's game versus Cleveland in the third inning as a result of right hamstring tightness.

injuries.name: Wenceel Perez
injuries.comment: Perez (orbital) was pulled off his rehab assignment Tuesday, Cody Stavenhagen of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Will Vest
injuries.comment: Vest (elbow) underwent hip surgery Tuesday, Chris McCosky of The Detroit News reports.

injuries.name: Brant Hurter
injuries.comment: The Tigers transferred Hurter (back) to Triple-A Toledo on Saturday to begin a rehab assignment, Emily Waldon of Baseball America reports.

injuries.name: Justin Verlander
injuries.comment: Verlander (hamstring/hip) threw off the front of the bullpen mound Wednesday, Jason Beck of MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Matt Vierling
injuries.comment: The Tigers placed Vierling on the 10-day injured list Friday, retroactive to Thursday, due to a left adductor strain.

injuries.name: Burch Smith
injuries.comment: Smith is being evaluated after exiting a rehab appearance with Triple-A Toledo on Thursday with right shoulder/lat discomfort, Cody Stavenhagen of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Bailey Horn
injuries.comment: Horn (elbow) will undergo season-ending Tommy John surgery, Chris McCosky of The Detroit News reports.

injuries.name: Parker Meadows
injuries.comment: Tigers manager A.J. Hinch said Tuesday that Meadows (forearm) has yet to resume hitting and is without a timeline to return from the 60-day injured list, Evan Petzold of the Detroit Free Press reports.

injuries.name: Trey Sweeney
injuries.comment: Sweeney will undergo season-ending shoulder surgery this week, Cody Stavenhagen of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Reese Olson
injuries.comment: The Tigers placed Olson on the 60-day injured list Tuesday after he underwent a right shoulder labral repair Feb. 2 that will result in him missing the 2026 season.

injuries.name: Bryan Woo
injuries.comment: Woo (shoulder) threw his normal between-starts bullpen session Thursday, Zach Sweet of MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Luke Raley
injuries.comment: The Mariners transferred Raley (forearm) from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day IL on Wednesday.

injuries.name: J.P. Crawford
injuries.comment: Crawford (wrist) will start a rehab assignment with Triple-A Tacoma on Thursday, Tim Booth of The Seattle Times reports.

injuries.name: Matt Brash
injuries.comment: Brash (lat) is scheduled to throw a bullpen session Saturday, Adam Jude of The Seattle Times reports.

injuries.name: Colt Emerson
injuries.comment: The Mariners placed Emerson on the 10-day injured list Friday with left wrist inflammation, Adam Jude of The Seattle Times reports.

injuries.name: Cooper Criswell
injuries.comment: Mariners general manager Justin Hollander said July 31 that Criswell (shoulder) has resumed a throwing progression, MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Carlos Vargas
injuries.comment: Vargas (lat) is expected to begin a minor-league rehab assignment with High-A Everett on Saturday night, Ryan Divish of The Seattle Times reports.

injuries.name: Cole Wilcox
injuries.comment: Wilcox left Thursday's game versus the Tigers due to left oblique tightness.

injuries.name: Will Wilson
injuries.comment: Wilson (thumb) has gone 3-for-9 with two RBI and a 1:2 BB:K in his first three rehab games between High-A Everett and Triple-A Tacoma.

injuries.name: Logan Evans
injuries.comment: The Mariners placed Evans (elbow) on the 60-day injured list Monday.

playoffOdds.method: Monte Carlo of remaining American League games. Each game uses log5 win odds from Pythagorean record, season record, last-10 form, home-field advantage, and injured-list drag.
playoffOdds.note: 24.9% of 5,000 sims have Toronto as a division winner or one of the three AL wild cards. Models 329 remaining games involving AL clubs.
